scope: Additive Eternal Tome L1-18 Grand Warden active immunity audit for standard Home Village attack; no change to the frozen 2026-09-17 reference.
game_version: Official June 2025 aura revision and October 2025 auto-activation fix; dated secondary client build 18.600.3; pinned raw commit 62b019df868f9decb49e97a0ff5ae15fb27af9ba.

sources.title: Hero Equipment
facts: Eternal Tome is Common active Grand Warden Equipment; Warden and nearby units become immune to damage.
sources.limitations: No aura radius, falloff, activation phase, duration by level, damage-origin exceptions or target-class details.

sources.title: Welcome to Let’s Get Crafty Update!
facts: Ability duration increased by 0.2 seconds at every level.
Damage immunity persists for 1 second after a Troop exits the Grand Warden aura.
Troops entering the aura after activation gain damage immunity.
sources.limitations: Does not provide absolute per-level durations, aura shape/radius or exact tick boundary and simultaneous damage order.

sources.title: Get Ready for Ranked! - Update
facts: Fixed Grand Warden being defeated during auto-activation of Eternal Tome.
sources.limitations: Does not state when auto-activation occurs relative to lethal damage or other same-tick events.

sources.title: Eternal Tome — Clash of Clans Wiki
sources.version: Client build 18.600.3 as claimed by source
facts: Dated table confirms Common Grand Warden Equipment L1-18, upgrade ore costs and immunity description.
sources.limitations: The table has no current duration or aura geometry column.

sources.title: Eternal Tome upgrade data
facts: The page lists post-update L1-18 duration values matching the pinned raw duration series and records the June 2025 +0.2 second change.
sources.limitations: Does not establish current September 2026 effect continuity, aura geometry or tick rules.

sources.title: Pinned Eternal Tome Home Village Hero Equipment record
facts: Pinned payload has 18 abilityDuration values from 3.2 to 8.2 seconds, with no radius or immunity mechanics fields.
sources.limitations: The raw values must not receive an extra +0.2 seconds without proof that they predate the official June 2025 change.

observations.note: All listed durations and the exit grace are exact 10 ms multiples. The official +0.2 second change is already reflected in the pinned post-June duration table; no extra increment is imported.

derivations.result: Retain pinned duration and ore fields as catalogue data
derivations.method: Convert pinned seconds to integer milliseconds for audit only; compare the series with the dated post-June table and retain raw fields unchanged.

derivations.result: Document Warden damage immunity, aura entry protection and 1000 ms exit grace
derivations.method: Read the December 2023 Equipment description and June 2025 official balance notes together; do not choose unreported geometry or timing order.

rejected_inferences.rule: Increase pinned duration values by 200 ms
rejected_inferences.reason: The pinned values match a post-June 2025 table; the official note describes a historical change, not an additional current modifier.

rejected_inferences.rule: Use Grand Warden's attack range or visual ring as Eternal Tome aura radius
rejected_inferences.reason: No current source checked pins the Equipment aura radius and inclusion geometry.

rejected_inferences.rule: Include Pets, spawned Equipment children, other Heroes and siege machines as protected Troops
rejected_inferences.reason: The official update says Troops and the Equipment description says nearby units; entity class membership and exclusions are not defined.

rejected_inferences.rule: Suppress every damage origin and non-damage effect
rejected_inferences.reason: The official wording promises damage immunity, while slowdown, displacement, status effects and scripted removal need separate evidence.

rejected_inferences.rule: Apply immunity before a lethal hit or trigger auto-activation on that tick
rejected_inferences.reason: The October 2025 bug fix does not specify the activation and damage event order.

items: current L1-18 duration continuity after the pinned post-June table
aura center, radius, shape, entity geometry and boundary inclusion
eligible Troop, Hero, Pet, spawned child, siege and defensive classes
activation, movement, aura entry/exit, grace expiration and damage order on a 10 ms tick
Warden death, Phoenix revival, auto-activation and simultaneous lethal hit interactions
damage-origin exceptions, status effects and stacking with other mitigation
Viewer aura/control/overlay, snapshot, replay and RL activation state

conclusion: Eternal Tome L1-18 remains partial and catalogue-only. Official sources establish active Warden and nearby-unit damage immunity, post-activation Troop entry and a 1-second exit grace; current aura geometry, eligibility and tick order remain unresolved.
